modes.description: Preview only — show what would be cleaned up. No changes made.
modes.output: Cleanup plan report: keep list, delete list, confirm list, size delta

modes.description: Archive project: preserve CORE_EVIDENCE, prune CACHE, set status=ARCHIVED, disable default mount.
modes.output: Archive report: what was archived, what was preserved

modes.description: Freeze project: preserve all, set status=FROZEN, disable default mount. No cleanup.
modes.output: Freeze report: project frozen, no auto-mount

modes.description: Prune CACHE + STALE + DUPLICATE. Preserve CORE_EVIDENCE and PHASE_ARTIFACTS.
modes.output: Prune report: what was removed, size reclaimed
modes.safety: CORE_EVIDENCE and PHASE_ARTIFACTS preserved. DUPLICATE keeps highest sourceTier.

modes.description: Delete project from Context Space. Requires PLAN preview + explicit CONFIRM.
modes.output: Delete report: what was deleted, what evidence was preserved (if any)
modes.safety: 2-step: PLAN → review → CONFIRM. CORE_EVIDENCE requires --force-evidence flag. CORE_EVIDENCE deleted last.
